title: A Two-Step Synthetic Control Approach for Estimating Causal Effects of Marketing Events
eligible_reason: Methodological paper proposing a two-step synthetic control (TSSC) estimator; simulations and an empirical application with one treated unit and donor controls (Nielsen retail scanner data). Synthetic control is excluded; no staggered TWFE DiD.
design_notes: MATLAB TSSC code (SC, MSC(a)-(c)) on Data.csv (one treated series, ten controls); R script processes Kilts Nielsen scanner data into a state-week panel.
data_files_note: ReadMe: Nielsen Retail Scanner data require a Kilts subscription and are not released; Data.csv is a mock (synthetic) dataset.
data_provenance_note: Only a mock dataset is shipped; real Nielsen data not included.
